description: Reduce centered vocals for karaoke practice using the classic L−R center-channel technique. Honest about its limits.

faqs.a: Subtracting right from left cancels anything panned center — usually the lead vocal, but also kick, bass and snare. Stereo effects and off-center backing vocals survive.
It only works on true stereo tracks with centered vocals. Mono files, and songs with stereo or off-center vocals, won't reduce properly.
Yes — processing happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Click "Reduce vocals" — the center channel is cancelled with the L−R technique.
title: Karaoke Voice Reducer
